rule: SI 2016 reg 14(1)-(2): a sign in place before 22 April 2016 that is of a size, colour and type prescribed by the 2002 Regulations is treated as prescribed. Reg 14(4) signs could also be placed in the first 12 weeks. Status '2002-legacy' = lawful if already in place, not for new signs. 2919.1 lost that protection on 30 January 2022 (reg 14(3)).
